overview: The Committee of the Whole reviewed proposed FY24 departmental budgets for the Water and Sewer Enterprise Fund, the Medford Public Library, the Medford Public Schools, and Debt Service. The committee took no final action on the budget but approved a motion requesting an accounting of school department consultant expenditures.

items.title: Water and Sewer Enterprise Fund
items.summary: DPW Commissioner Tim McGivern and staff presented the enterprise fund budget, discussing plans for in-house water main replacements, water quality positions, lead pipe replacement, and a forthcoming long-term rate study.

items.title: Medford Public Library
items.summary: Director Barbara Kerr reported surging patron usage and programming at the new facility but emphasized that ordinary expense funding remains below FY17 levels, drawing strong council and public support for increased funding for books and staffing.

items.title: Medford Public Schools
items.summary: Superintendent Marice Edouard-Vincent presented the School Committee's $71,995,165 requested budget, detailing literacy curriculum investments, full-day Wednesdays, and the cuts to coaches, theater, and library positions that would occur under a lower figure.

items.title: Debt Service and Bonds
items.summary: Finance Director Bob Dickinson presented the $6,474,578 debt service budget and reviewed Medford's relatively low debt burden in comparison to neighboring communities.

items.title: School Consultant Spending Information Request
items.summary: Approved a motion requesting that the school administration provide the total amount spent on consultants across the school system.
